origin: cwe/352/csharp Key Principles: MVC anti-forgery filters do not run for Minimal API endpoints; use app.UseAntiforgery()

finding.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
finding.summary: A cookie-authenticated Minimal API POST endpoint changes account email and requires authorization, but the pipeline never calls UseAntiforgery().

trap: Adding [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] or AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute as if this were MVC, or relying on RequireAuthorization()/SameSite alone. Minimal API endpoints need antiforgery middleware in the pipeline and a validated request token.
must_preserve: Authorized clients with valid antiforgery tokens can still POST /account/email and receive 202 Accepted. Authentication and authorization middleware remain in place, and the endpoint still calls EmailChangeService.QueueAsync().
